independent_check: Revision 6.0.2: deterministic public-output checks plus evaluator-owned independent refitting of the declared model protocol on every outer split and inner fold, including declared PCA solver parameters. No submitted code execution or arbitrary internals are verified; unsupported but potentially valid methods are REVIEW_REQUIRED (Harbor reward.json review_required=1; no scalar pass/fail reward).

observations.name: public_output_and_declared_protocol_refit
observations.expected: All seven required output files are checked against public inputs; row metrics and repeat intervals are recalculated; the declared model protocol is independently refit over every paired split and inner fold.
observations.acceptance_rule: At least two training sizes and at least 20 unique paired repeats per size; all three arms share each split and fixed test set. Predictions must match the evaluator-owned refit and all derived metrics. This verifies only the declared protocol on public targets; it does not prove blindness, submitted-code execution, or arbitrary candidate internals. Different model-selection designs across arms may be scientifically valid but are REVIEW_REQUIRED when outside the integrated refit vocabulary, not scientific failures.
